archetypes.name: startup-lock-parity
archetypes.rationale: Shared Python/Bash mutex behavior is the core risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the renamed startup-lock implementation in Python and Bash. Focus on whether Codex and Cursor now contend on one path across both lanes, whether unsupported tools and non-Darwin platforms still no-op, and whether tests would catch path drift or empty USER divergence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-surface-sweep
archetypes.rationale: The helper rename touches several launcher call sites and docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the call-site rename across probe, negotiation, auth-retry, review wrapper, lint-fix, and review-and-fix paths. Check that no old env var or helper name remains on live surfaces and that docs/security text matches the implemented behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
